summary: Borealis Foods Inc. issued a $3M convertible promissory note to its largest shareholder Oxus Capital Pte Ltd. (39.09% owner) on May 29, 2026. The note carries 10% interest, matures August 29, 2026 (extendable pending shareholder approval), and is convertible at $1.45/share. Proceeds target accounts payable and working capital. Conversion requires Nasdaq shareholder approval due to related-party and overhang rules (~2.07M shares). The filing details a debt financing rather than a transformative event; the note is short-dated and bespoke. Watch for shareholder vote timing and potential dilution-driven price pressure.
